note: Phase 2 identity masters, October 28, 2026. Chromium at device scale 1 on Linux. Crisp share: ink pixels at 90 percent coverage or more, over ink pixels at 10 percent or more (D1-17 passes at 0.60). Open counters: enclosed background regions at 16 px. One color: largest RGB distance of a pixel from the surface-to-ink line. Contrast: median WCAG contrast of ink pixels against the surface.
